source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 03 New Optimizer tool (15in L).pdf
title: 15in Optimizer Tool
lead: MOC has developed a new universal Optimizer™ tool to accommodate the use of Optimizer™ on various models.
body: This tool is known to accommodate the use of Optimizer™ on 5.4L Ford F-150s and Expeditions. This new tool enables the tech to use Optimizer™ on the Throttle Body without removing the air filter box.
The MOC Optimizer™ product (Part No. 16501) is sold separately.
